considerations: Vehicle access is available from Harbor Isle Blvd into paved parking lots around the blue-roof building cluster. The site sits at the street edge of a large industrial campus, immediately across from Pelican Elementary School. Neighboring campus structures include a large warehouse, process equipment, and additional plant buildings. A golf course and water body sit beyond the plant. Trees along the street may limit some sightlines. Lots and drive lanes provide circulation around the cluster.
